premises.text: Indoor growers' profits depend on controlling many growing conditions, but sensor/notebook data stays siloed and useless for decisions
premises.evidence_span: this is raw data. It doesn't talk to each other, and it doesn't tell Tom anything. It's virtually useless for Tom

premises.text: AgriList aggregates sensor sync, document upload, and manual entry into one operational data place
premises.evidence_span: AgriList can automatically sync with any hardware he has in the equipment, like sensors. He can upload documents. And he can even enter data manually

premises.text: Dashboard, graphs, and task management surface harvest/seed work and yield risks to operations and sales
premises.evidence_span: Agoralyst also acts as a task manager, showing Tom what he has to do on a day-to-day basis

premises.text: Recommendations optimize lighting against time-varying electricity rates to cut energy cost
premises.evidence_span: AgriList goes a step further and provides recommendations to show Tom when he should turn on and off his lights to achieve maximal savings

premises.text: Subscription priced per acre per month for greenhouse customers
premises.evidence_span: Our private beta was released at a subscription price at $1,000 per acre per month

premises.text: Target market is large and growing indoor/hydroponic vegetable greenhouse acreage
premises.evidence_span: There are over 1 million acres of vegetable production greenhouses globally. And that number is growing fast

domains.name: Unified ops platform and energy recommendations

value.text: Indoor farmers control operations and profits with less guesswork
value.evidence_span: helps indoor farmers take control of their operations

secondary_value.text: More sustainable efficient food production at scale
secondary_value.evidence_span: We have to increase food production 70% by 2050 to meet our growing global food demand. And we have to do that more sustainably and more efficiently

causal_links.evidence_span: being able to control those conditions means being able to control your profits
all of Tom's data talks to each other, eliminating the guesswork from decision making
subscription price at $1,000 per acre per month

notes: Lighting/temp/CO2/pH/humidity sensor list and notebook/consultant/gut decision pains folded as one siloed-data problem. Dashboard/graphs/tasks are one ops surface; energy recommendations kept separately revisable. Beta greenhouse count treated as traction. Singleton D1 retained. Anti-template: problem, product, commercial modules separately framed.
